behavior: When the active item of a composite changes while the focus is outside the composite, the tab stop moves to that item. A native reset, a controlled value that the parent changes, and an active item that mounts late are such changes. When such a change leaves no active item, or an active item that is disabled or hidden, the tab stop moves to the first enabled item. When the focus leaves the composite, the tab stop goes back to the active item. While the composite has the focus, the tab stop stays on the item that the user chose. The Tab key thus enters a Radio Group on the checked radio. In Base UI, a Radio Group keeps the tab stop on the radio that had the focus last. A registered item that has focus in another document keeps the tab stop until focus leaves it. Its arrow keys still reach the composite root.
